Botanica Chalong Bay

Villa in Chalong (Soi Pa Lai 2)
HomeSaleBotanica Chalong Bay

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions) and brochure plans. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed villas.

Project overview

Botanica Chalong Bay is a new estate by Botanica Luxury Phuket, the developer of Botanica Grand Avenue and Botanica Hythe, on Soi Pa Lai 2 on the east side of Chalong. It has 28 two-storey, four-bedroom villas on a site of about 24,000 sqm, in several contemporary designs (types A to E, 4B, C1A and C1B) with large glass walls, timber ceilings and private pools.

Advertised villas range from about 380 to 430 sqm of built area on plots of roughly 470 to 540 sqm, with five bathrooms. The estate has landscaped common gardens, parking and 24-hour security; pets are allowed.

The JW Marriott Chalong Bay is about 5 minutes away, Ruamrudee International School about 9 minutes and Robinson Lifestyle Chalong about 14 minutes; Chalong Pier is about 3.5 km away. The project is off plan, with payments linked to construction stages.
